title: Woodpecker Ka Super Brain
idea: How woodpeckers withstand 1000 g impacts without brain damage

lines.text: Woodpecker ped par lagatar sar patak kar bhi behosh kyon nahi hota?
Ped thokte waqt ye 1000 g ka zabardast deceleration force jhelta hai!
Iski lambi jeebh dimaag ke chaaron taraf ghoomkar safety-belt ban jaati hai!
Shareer 99 percent jhatka sookh leta hai aur dimaag par sirf 1 percent!
Scientists ne isi bird se inspire hokar helmets aur airplane black-boxes banaye!
Kya insaan nature ke is kamaal helmet ko kabhi beat kar payega?

youtube.title: Woodpecker Ped Thok Kar Behosh Kyon Nahi Hota? 🪵 #shorts
youtube.description:
Woodpecker ped par sar thokte waqt 1000 g ka shock jhelta hai bina kisi brain damage ke! Aakhir iska natural helmet kaise kaam karta hai? Dekhiye is video mein.

#woodpecker #facts #animals #sciencefacts #shorts

facts.claim: Woodpeckers can withstand decelerations of 1000 g while pecking.
Around 99% of pecking force is absorbed by the body, leaving only 1% in the head.
